name: HIPAA
description: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act - Privacy and Security Rules

controls.name: Security Management Process
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to prevent, detect, contain, and correct security violations.

controls.name: Information System Activity Review
controls.description: Implement procedures to regularly review records of information system activity.

controls.name: Security Awareness and Training
controls.description: Implement a security awareness and training program for all members of its workforce.

controls.name: Security Incident Procedures
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to address security incidents.

controls.name: Contingency Plan
controls.description: Establish policies and procedures for responding to an emergency or other occurrence.

controls.name: Evaluation
controls.description: Perform a periodic technical and nontechnical evaluation.

controls.name: Facility Access Controls
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to limit physical access to electronic information systems.

controls.name: Workstation Use
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures that specify the proper functions to be performed.

controls.name: Workstation Security
controls.description: Implement physical safeguards for all workstations that may access electronic protected health information.

controls.name: Device and Media Controls
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures that govern the receipt and removal of hardware and electronic media.

controls.name: Access Control
controls.description: Implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems that allow only authorized persons to access electronic protected health information.

controls.name: Audit Controls
controls.description: Implement hardware, software, and/or procedural mechanisms that record and examine activity in information systems.

controls.name: Integrity Controls
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to protect electronic protected health information from improper alteration or destruction.

controls.name: Authentication
controls.description: Implement procedures to verify that a person or entity seeking access to electronic protected health information is the one claimed.

controls.name: Transmission Security
controls.description: Implement technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to electronic protected health information that is being transmitted over an electronic communications network.

controls.name: Encryption and Decryption
controls.description: Implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt electronic protected health information.

controls.name: Business Associate Agreements
controls.description: A covered entity may permit a business associate to create, receive, maintain, or transmit electronic protected health information on its behalf.

controls.name: Privacy Practices Notice
controls.description: A covered entity must provide a notice of its privacy practices.

controls.name: Privacy Officer
controls.description: A covered entity must designate a privacy official responsible for developing and implementing its privacy policies and procedures.

controls.name: Privacy Training
controls.description: A covered entity must train all members of its workforce on the policies and procedures with respect to protected health information.
